note: A UNHCR case study of refugees' inclusion in the Fayda digital ID. It names the national civil registry system only to recommend two-way interoperability with the digital ID and refugee systems, and says vital events of refugees are still registered by RRS; it does not say what the civil registry system does or how any office records an event.
